name: Wrench Swap (Going Commando)
author: Slim Cognito
description: Adds Wrench Swap to the pause menu's Options: switch between the Omniwrench 8000, 10000 and 12000 once you have found them (or from the start with Cheat Mode).

settings.description: Normal games: all three Omniwrenches selectable from the start, kept from level to level. Challenge mode is unchanged.
